packMeta.name: Clinic Front Desk (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey clinic reception and patient flow desk: live waiting room queue, patient directory and dossiers, digital intake and consent forms, clinician roster, and follow-up recall queue. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
